fusions.name: Sluggish Chill
fusions.desc: Bursts a chill around you, dealing 10 frost damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 0.8 seconds and leaving them [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spat Venom
fusions.desc: Spits at an enemy for 4 poison damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail Left Behind
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Sunlit Scales
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%. You gain 5% dodge chance.
